label: ScreenBeam (Actiontec) ECB7250 MoCA 2.5 adapter
description: Bonded MoCA 2.5 network adapter with a 2.5Gbps MoCA PHY and one 10/100/2500BASE-T RJ45 port - ScreenBeam's first-to-market 2.5GbE MoCA adapter, giving multi-gigabit full-duplex over existing coax. Backward compatible with MoCA 2.0/1.1/1.0, up to 16 nodes; the same hardware is sold as the Actiontec ECB7250.
